name: calendar_find_slots
title: Find free slots
description: Find meeting slots when every attendee is free. Use this first, before holding a slot. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Returns up to 10 slots, each with a slot id, start time and end time. Changes nothing.

attendees.description: Email addresses of everyone who must attend.

duration_minutes.description: Length of the meeting in minutes.

latest_date.description: Last day to search. Defaults to seven days after earliest_date.

name: calendar_hold_slot
title: Hold a slot
description: Hold one slot from calendar_find_slots so nobody else can take it. Use this when the user has picked a slot but not yet confirmed. The hold lasts 10 minutes and then expires. Returns a hold id.

slot_id.description: A slot id returned by calendar_find_slots.

name: calendar_confirm_booking
title: Confirm a booking
description: Turn a hold into a booked meeting. Use this only after the user confirms the slot, and before the hold expires. Takes a hold id, which starts with hold_. If the hold has expired, find and hold a new slot. Returns the booking id.

notify.description: Whether to email the invitation to attendees.

name: calendar_cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
description: Cancel a booked meeting and tell every attendee. Use this only when the user clearly asks to cancel. Takes a booking id, which starts with evt_. This cannot be undone. Returns a confirmation.

reason.description: Short reason included in the message to attendees.
